opportunities.exact_theorem: Over every characteristic-zero field F, every nonzero polynomial P in n variables that is a product of affine linear factors and factors having at most two monomials, with total degree D, satisfies ord_0 P(log(1+z),...,log(1+z/n)) <= nD. Each binomial c x^alpha+d x^beta individually has contact <= D+n-1; after equal-degree leading cancellation its extra contact is the first nonzero inverse-pole moment of alpha-beta and is at most its support size minus one.
opportunities.mechanism: Normalize ell_i=(z/i)g(z/i), use nonzero coefficients of h(u)=log g(u), linearize the ratio of two normalized monomials, and apply Vandermonde separation of exponent moments. Add contact under products.

strongest_primary_comparator.statement_read: Theorems 1.1 and 3.1 give polynomial hitting sets through total derivative dimension r, using truncated logarithms. They do not replace r by circuit size.

classical_ingredient.statement_read: The coefficients of log(log(1+u)/u) are (-1)^k C_{2,k}/(k k!) with C_{2,k}>0.

opportunities.novelty: UNKNOWN; coefficient ingredient is classical; no foundational novelty claimed
opportunities.significance: A sharp bound for the fixed logarithmic curve on a factor class containing products with exponential derivative dimension. It removes the linear-state obstruction in this scoped class, but that class already has elementary PIT methods.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma_for_endpoint: Control many-term cancellation at additions of products, uniformly in n, circuit size, degree, and number of terms, without full monomial or derivative-span expansion; then survive arbitrary shared/nested circuit operations.
compatibility_obligations: Keep total degree D in the complexity parameters.
The factorization is a class promise and need not be acquired by the black box.
Keep rational generator construction bit cost separate from arbitrary black-box evaluation and scalar encoding.
opportunities.falsification: The universal binomial statement has a complete moment proof. Finite exact diagnostics checked 6674 exhaustive and 268 seeded normalized binomials. No extension from pairs to arbitrary sums is asserted; an explicit three-unit analytic counterexample refutes that abstract inference.

opportunities.exact_theorem: For N distinct nonzero complex source poles a_i and lambda_i=log(1+z/a_i), if a rational function T(z,x) has rational derivative after substitution x=lambda(z), then T=r(z)+sum_i c_i x_i with r in C(z) and constant c_i. If T(lambda)=log g for rational g, then r is constant and c_i are integer divisor multiplicities. Consequently an exact rational-log readout of log(1+R(z)/a)-log(1+R(0)/a) forces ord_0(R-R(0)) <= N.
opportunities.mechanism: Monodromy turns each logarithmic lattice translation into a constant difference. Rational functions with a nonzero additive period are constant in that variable. Rational logarithmic derivatives have only simple poles and no polynomial part, removing the residual rational term. Vandermonde derivatives bound local ramification.

strongest_source_comparator.citation: ASTRA N250, exact state Section 9, lines 430-452
strongest_source_comparator.scope: A fixed-alphabet rational pullback obstruction from Riemann-Hurwitz. The present proof permits growing alphabets and z-dependent rational readouts, but bounds local ramification rather than global degree.

opportunities.novelty: UNKNOWN; elementary monodromy and primitive-extension ingredients; no novelty or external certification claimed
opportunities.significance: Closes the precise growing-alphabet/rational-readout loophole for producing high contact by exact rational pullback of a seed already known to have bounded contact.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma_for_endpoint: None for this scoped obstruction; a genuinely different many-term circuit cancellation mechanism is still needed for N250.
compatibility_obligations: The representation must be exact as an analytic or meromorphic germ.
The base point must be ordinary for the source logarithms and the target logarithm.
The bound is on local ramification, not global rational degree.
A seed whose contact is already unknown is not controlled by this obstruction.
opportunities.falsification: The bound is sharp. R=z^2/(z+1) satisfies ell_4(R)=2 ell_2-ell_1 with contact two and two source logs. Global degree is explicitly separated by R=(1+z)^M-1, which has arbitrary global degree but local ramification one.

next_decisive_general_gate: Prove an explicit uniform polynomial B(n,s,D) for contact through arbitrary circuit additions and products, or construct explicit degree-poly(n), size-poly(n) nonzero P_n with superpolynomial contact on the fixed logarithmic curve. Dense interpolation nullvectors, huge-degree binomial powers, and the conditional hitting-set reduction do not meet this gate.
